Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Per before. Ankara says you pay half the cost.

> have thought that "pays only half of the blood cost" is
> just another way of writing "burns half as much blood as
> the card costs", which would be an equivalent (though
> different) effect to the Path-type effects. Or is there
> another reason I'm missing that makes it different from
> Path's cost-payment-reduction?

Path: "burn 1 less blood when playing cards that require [Discipline]".

Q: One less than what?
A: Than the amount of blood the vampire would pay otherwise.

Ankara: The vampire pays half the "cost".
(Not "burn half as much as he would have otherwise").

So figure the cost of the card. (Neither Ankara nor the Path affect
this).
With the cost figured, the vampire pays half the cost.
And the vampire burns 1 less blood.
